planSteps.description: Scroll down to the 'Declarative Security Policies' section
Click the second policy tab titled '2. Enforce Multi-Tenant Isolation'
The YAML code view updates to show policy name 'multi-tenant-isolation' and require_header_context 'X-Tenant-ID'
Click the third policy tab titled '3. Block Forbidden System Calls (Syscall)'
The YAML code view updates to show policy name 'syscall-process-protection' and match syscalls 'execve' and 'ptrace'
